The Xbox One clears its cache every time it completely powers off and has to redownload that information at startup. So if you have Energy-Saver mode enabled, turning on your console will force the Xbox One to redownload about 215MB of data each and every time you power on the system, even if it's only been off for a few minutes.

For this reason, consider leaving your console in "Instant-On" mode, where the console goes to sleep instead of powering completely off, preserving its cache. It seems like neglectful design on Microsoft's part, but I wanted to share this information since I caught my Xbox using extra data and this information isn't well documented.
PSA if you have a low bandwidth cap and have XB1's "Energy-Saver" mode enabled
